note: Provider-neutral function schemas (JSON Schema in `parameters`). Map to Anthropic `input_schema` / OpenAI `function.parameters` in the LLM gateway adapter. `_meta` is for the router/gateway and must be stripped before sending to a provider. Includes virtual tools.

tools.name: user_get_profile
tools.description: Retrieve current authenticated user's profile details and assigned roles. Rules: Caller must be authenticated.

tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: List all active workspaces where the authenticated caller is an enrolled member. Rules: User must be authenticated.

tools.name: workspace_create
tools.description: Create a new workspace tenant, automatically assigning caller as Workspace Admin/Owner. Rules: Caller must be authenticated; workspace slug derived from name must be unique.

tools.name: workspace_tree_get
tools.description: Retrieve the complete structural hierarchy tree (Spaces -> Folders -> Lists) of a workspace. Rules: Caller must be an active member of the workspace.

tools.name: workspace_update
tools.description: Update metadata properties (name, description) of an existing workspace. Rules: Caller must have Admin role in workspace.

tools.name: workspace_members_list
tools.description: List all users enrolled in a workspace along with their tenant roles. Rules: Caller must be an active member of the workspace.

tools.name: workspace_member_add
tools.description: Add an existing user to the workspace with a designated workspace role. Rules: User must exist in system; user must not already be an enrolled member.

user_id.description: User id or email. Accepts: workspace member name, email or user id (resolved server-side)

role.description: Role name. Must be valid role string

tools.name: workspace_member_update_role
tools.description: Update the assigned role of an existing workspace member. Rules: Caller must be workspace admin; cannot demote the sole remaining admin.

user_id.description: User id or member name. Accepts: workspace member name, email or user id (resolved server-side)

tools.name: workspace_member_remove
tools.description: Remove a member from the workspace, immediately revoking all workspace resource access. Rules: Cannot remove the last admin of the workspace.

user_id.description: User id or member name. Accepts: workspace member name, email or user id (resolved server-side)

tools.name: space_get
tools.description: Retrieve details, configuration, status, and metadata of a specific Space. Rules: Space must exist in caller's workspace.

space_id.description: Space id or space name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: space_create
tools.description: Create a top-level Space container inside a workspace, setting up its workflow and issue key prefix. Rules: Caller must have permission to create spaces in the workspace.

workflow_id.description: Workflow template id. Accepts: workflow name or id (resolved server-side)

tools.name: space_update
tools.description: Update metadata or settings of an existing Space (name, description, workflow_id). Rules: Space must not be frozen or archived (guarded by `services/write_guard.py`).

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: space_archive
tools.description: Archive a Space, rendering it read-only and hiding it from active sidebar queries. Rules: Space must not already be archived.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: space_unarchive
tools.description: Restore an archived Space back to active status, re-enabling write operations. Rules: Space must currently be archived.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: space_freeze
tools.description: Freeze a Space during organizational migrations or compliance audits, blocking all writes. Rules: Space must not already be frozen.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: space_unfreeze
tools.description: Unfreeze a Space, lifting HTTP 423 Locked restrictions and allowing modifications again. Rules: Space must currently be frozen.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: folder_create
tools.description: Create a Folder container inside a Space to organize multiple lists. Rules: Parent Space must not be frozen or archived.

space_id.description: Parent space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: folder_update
tools.description: Update folder name or metadata. Rules: Folder and parent space must not be frozen or archived.

folder_id.description: Folder id or name. Accepts: folder name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: folder_archive
tools.description: Archive a Folder and all child lists within it. Rules: Folder must not already be archived.

folder_id.description: Folder id or name. Accepts: folder name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: folder_unarchive
tools.description: Unarchive a previously archived folder and restore its visibility. Rules: Folder must currently be archived.

folder_id.description: Folder id or name. Accepts: folder name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: list_create
tools.description: Create a new issue List under a Space or within a Folder. Rules: Parent space/folder must not be frozen or archived.

space_id.description: Parent space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

folder_id.description: Parent folder id or name. Accepts: folder name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: list_update
tools.description: Update list metadata or name. Rules: List and parent container must not be frozen or archived.

list_id.description: List id or name. Accepts: list name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: list_archive
tools.description: Archive a List, hiding it and marking its tickets as non-editable under write guard. Rules: List must not already be archived.

list_id.description: List id or name. Accepts: list name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: list_unarchive
tools.description: Unarchive a previously archived List and restore write access to its tickets. Rules: List must currently be archived.

list_id.description: List id or name. Accepts: list name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: governance_settings_get
tools.description: Retrieve workspace governance policies including WIP limits, workflow enforcement, and estimation rules. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: governance_settings_update
tools.description: Update workspace governance policies and transition rules. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin.

tools.name: issue_list
tools.description: Query, search, filter, and paginate issues across lists, spaces, or the entire workspace. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

space_id.description: Space filter. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

list_id.description: List filter. Accepts: list name or UUID (resolved server-side)

assignee_id.description: User id or name. Accepts: workspace member name, email or user id (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_board_get
tools.description: Retrieve board column groupings of issues organized by workflow stages for a space or list. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

space_id.description: Space context. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

sprint_id.description: Active sprint filter. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_backlog_get
tools.description: Fetch unassigned or backlog issues ordered by rank for sprint planning. Rules: Space must exist in caller's workspace.

space_id.description: Space id. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_key_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an issue key (e.g. 'ENG-104') to its full issue entity and UUID. Rules: Issue with key must exist in workspace.

tools.name: issue_get
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive details, fields, assignee, status, and dates of a specific issue by UUID. Rules: Issue must exist in workspace.

issue_id.description: Issue uuid. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_create
tools.description: Create a new issue/ticket in a designated list, allocating an auto-incrementing key. Rules: Target list and space must not be frozen or archived.

list_id.description: Target list id or name. Accepts: list name or UUID (resolved server-side)

assignee_id.description: Assignee name or user id. Accepts: workspace member name, email or user id (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_update
tools.description: Update fields of an issue: title, description, status/stage, priority, type, points, due date, assignee. Rules: Issue container must not be frozen or archived; status change must satisfy governance WIP limits if enabled.

issue_id.description: Issue uuid or key. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

status.description: Status name. Must be valid workflow stage

assignee_id.description: Assignee. Accepts: workspace member name, email or user id (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_move
tools.description: Move an issue to a different list within the workspace, optionally keeping or remapping status. Rules: Both source and target lists must not be frozen or archived.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

target_list_id.description: Destination list. Accepts: list name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_rank_backlog
tools.description: Reorder an issue in the space backlog relative to adjacent issues using fractional ranking. Rules: Space must not be frozen or archived.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

prev_issue_id.description: Preceding issue. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

next_issue_id.description: Succeeding issue. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_delete
tools.description: Soft-delete an issue, detaching dependencies, comments, and time entries. Rules: Issue must exist; cannot be deleted if active running timer is tracking time against it.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: comment_list
tools.description: List all comments and discussion threads posted on a specific issue. Rules: Issue must exist in workspace.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: comment_create
tools.description: Post a new comment on an issue discussion thread. Rules: Parent issue container must not be frozen or archived.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: comment_update
tools.description: Edit the content of an existing comment previously made by the user. Rules: Caller must be comment author or workspace admin.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

comment_id.description: Comment id. Accepts: comment id from comment_list (resolved server-side)

tools.name: comment_delete
tools.description: Delete a comment from an issue. Rules: Caller must be author or workspace admin.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

comment_id.description: Comment id. Accepts: comment id from comment_list (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_ai_summary_request
tools.description: Trigger an asynchronous background AI job to digest and summarize an issue description, attachments, and comment thread. Rules: Issue must exist.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_ai_job_get
tools.description: Poll the status and completed markdown output of an asynchronous AI summarization task. Rules: Job must belong to workspace.

tools.name: dependency_list
tools.description: List all linked dependencies for an issue (blocks, blocked_by, relates_to, duplicates, clones). Rules: Issue must exist.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: dependency_create
tools.description: Link two issues together via a defined dependency relation (blocks, is blocked by, relates to). Rules: Both issues must exist; circular blocking relationships are validated.

issue_id.description: Source issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

target_issue_id.description: Target issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: dependency_delete
tools.description: Remove a link or blocking relationship between two issues. Rules: Dependency record must exist.

issue_id.description: Source issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_list
tools.description: List all sprints for a space, filtering by status (planned, active, completed). Rules: Space must exist in workspace.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_create
tools.description: Create a new planned sprint iteration with a name, goal, and target dates. Rules: Space must not be frozen or archived.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_get
tools.description: Get sprint details, dates, goal, and status by sprint UUID. Rules: Sprint must exist.

sprint_id.description: Sprint id or name. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_update
tools.description: Update sprint properties like name, goal, and schedule dates. Rules: Sprint must not be in 'completed' status.

sprint_id.description: Sprint id or name. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_delete
tools.description: Delete a planned sprint, returning all assigned tickets back to the backlog. Rules: Sprint must not be currently active; only 'planned' sprints can be deleted.

sprint_id.description: Sprint id or name. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_start
tools.description: Transition a planned sprint to 'active' status. Validates governance estimation policies and checks no other sprint is active if single active sprint policy is on. Rules: Sprint must be in 'planned' status; space must not already have an active sprint; governance policy checks passed.

sprint_id.description: Sprint id or name. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_close
tools.description: Complete an active sprint, recording completion metrics and optionally moving incomplete tickets to the next sprint or backlog. Rules: Sprint must be in 'active' status.

sprint_id.description: Sprint id or name. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

target_sprint_id.description: Destination sprint for incomplete issues. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_issues_list
tools.description: List all issues assigned to a sprint iteration. Rules: Sprint must exist.

sprint_id.description: Sprint id or name. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_issues_add
tools.description: Assign one or more issues to a sprint. Rules: Sprint must not be completed; issues must belong to same space as sprint.

sprint_id.description: Sprint id or name. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

issue_ids.description: List of issue keys or ids. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_issues_remove
tools.description: Remove one or more issues from a sprint and return them back to the space backlog. Rules: Sprint must not be completed.

sprint_id.description: Sprint id or name. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

issue_ids.description: List of issue keys or ids. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_report_get
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive velocity, committed vs completed story points, and rollover report for a sprint. Rules: Sprint must exist.

sprint_id.description: Sprint id or name. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: sprint_burndown_get
tools.description: Retrieve daily burndown timeseries data comparing ideal trend line against actual remaining points/hours. Rules: Sprint must exist.

sprint_id.description: Sprint id or name. Accepts: sprint name/number (within a space) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: space_velocity_get
tools.description: Calculate historical sprint velocity (points committed vs completed) across recent sprints for a space. Rules: Space must exist.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: space_cfd_get
tools.description: Retrieve Cumulative Flow Diagram (CFD) distribution data showing issues across workflow stages over time. Rules: Space must exist.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: space_cycle_time_get
tools.description: Calculate average lead time and cycle time for issues completed within a time window. Rules: Space must exist.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: release_list
tools.description: List all software releases/versions in a space or workspace. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: release_create
tools.description: Create a new planned release / version milestone. Rules: Space must exist and not be frozen/archived.

space_id.description: Space id or name. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: release_get
tools.description: Get release details, progress, and linked issues. Rules: Release must exist.

release_id.description: Release id or version. Accepts: release name, version or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: release_update
tools.description: Update release metadata, description, or target date. Rules: Release must not already be shipped.

release_id.description: Release id or version. Accepts: release name, version or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: release_delete
tools.description: Delete a release version, unlinking associated fix version tags from issues. Rules: Release must not already be shipped.

release_id.description: Release id or version. Accepts: release name, version or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: release_ship
tools.description: Ship/mark release as deployed and completed, locking its version tags and compiling release notes. Rules: Release must be in 'unreleased' status.

release_id.description: Release id or version. Accepts: release name, version or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: release_notes_get
tools.description: Generate markdown release notes grouped by issue type (Features, Bug Fixes, Chores) for a release. Rules: Release must exist.

release_id.description: Release id or version. Accepts: release name, version or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: release_fix_versions_list
tools.description: List all fix versions assigned to a specific issue. Rules: Issue must exist.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: release_fix_versions_set
tools.description: Set or replace the list of fix versions assigned to an issue. Rules: Issue and releases must exist; issue container must not be frozen or archived.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

release_ids.description: List of release ids or version names. Accepts: release name, version or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: saved_view_list
tools.description: List custom saved filter views created by user or shared across the workspace. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: saved_view_create
tools.description: Save current filter configuration, layout type (board/list), and sort orders as a persistent reusable view. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: saved_view_get
tools.description: Retrieve configuration and filter definitions of a saved view. Rules: View must exist.

view_id.description: View id or name. Accepts: view name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: saved_view_update
tools.description: Update filters, name, layout, or sharing permissions of an existing saved view. Rules: Caller must be view creator or workspace admin.

view_id.description: View id or name. Accepts: view name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: saved_view_delete
tools.description: Delete a custom saved view. Rules: Caller must be view creator or workspace admin.

view_id.description: View id or name. Accepts: view name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: time_tracking_issue_get
tools.description: Get total spent time, estimated time, and remaining time calculation for a specific issue. Rules: Issue must exist.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: time_entry_create
tools.description: Log manual time worked against an issue, specifying duration in minutes and optional work description. Rules: Issue container must not be frozen or archived; if lock_days policy is active, cannot log to locked periods.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: time_entry_update
tools.description: Update duration or description of an existing logged time entry. Rules: Caller must be entry owner or workspace admin; period not locked.

entry_id.description: Time entry id. Accepts: entry id from time_entries_list (resolved server-side)

tools.name: time_entry_delete
tools.description: Delete a logged time entry and deduct its minutes from the issue spent total. Rules: Caller must be entry owner or workspace admin; period not locked.

entry_id.description: Time entry id. Accepts: entry id from time_entries_list (resolved server-side)

tools.name: time_entries_list
tools.description: Query and filter time entries across users, issues, dates, or sprints. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

user_id.description: User filter. Accepts: workspace member name, email or user id (resolved server-side)

issue_id.description: Issue filter. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: time_report_get
tools.description: Generate aggregated timesheet report grouped by user, project, or issue for payroll/billing. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: timer_start
tools.description: Start the live stopwatch timer on an issue. Only one active timer is allowed per user globally. Rules: User must not already have an active timer running on any issue in the system.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: timer_get
tools.description: Get the caller's currently running live stopwatch timer. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: timer_stop
tools.description: Stop running stopwatch timer and automatically convert elapsed duration into a saved TimeEntry. Rules: Caller must have an active timer running.

tools.name: timer_discard
tools.description: Cancel and discard active timer without creating a time log entry. Rules: Caller must have an active timer running.

tools.name: time_tracking_settings_get
tools.description: Retrieve workspace time tracking configuration (billable tracking, daily targets, period lock days). Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: time_tracking_settings_update
tools.description: Update workspace time tracking configuration. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin.

tools.name: workflow_get
tools.description: Retrieve active workflow schema, stages, transitions, and rules for a space or workspace. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

space_id.description: Space id. Accepts: project/space name, key prefix or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: workflow_templates_list
tools.description: List standard workflow templates (e.g. Basic Kanban, Scrum, Bug Tracking, DevOps). Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: workflow_template_create
tools.description: Save current workflow schema as a reusable template for new spaces. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin.

tools.name: workflow_template_delete
tools.description: Delete a custom workflow template. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin; system default templates cannot be deleted.

template_id.description: Template id or name. Accepts: template name or id (resolved server-side)

tools.name: workflow_editors_list
tools.description: List users granted explicit permission to edit and publish workflows. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: workflow_editors_set
tools.description: Set or replace the list of users authorized to edit and publish workflows in the workspace. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin.

user_ids.description: List of user ids or emails. Accepts: workspace member name, email or user id (resolved server-side)

tools.name: report_catalog_get
tools.description: List all built-in report definitions, supported charts, and available filter parameters. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: report_run
tools.description: Execute synchronous analytical report query (e.g. throughput, issue distribution, cycle time). Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

report_type.description: Report type slug. Valid report type from catalog

tools.name: report_export
tools.description: Export report results directly as CSV or PDF download or enqueue export job. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: report_jobs_list
tools.description: List asynchronous export and scheduled report generation jobs. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: report_job_get
tools.description: Get status and progress of an asynchronous report job. Rules: Job must exist in workspace.

tools.name: saved_reports_list
tools.description: List custom saved reports created in the workspace. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: saved_report_create
tools.description: Save a report template with custom filters and chart parameters for one-click re-runs. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: saved_report_get
tools.description: Get configuration and execute a saved report. Rules: Report must exist.

report_id.description: Report id or name. Accepts: saved report name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: saved_report_update
tools.description: Update parameters or rename an existing saved report. Rules: Caller must be creator or admin.

report_id.description: Report id or name. Accepts: saved report name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: saved_report_delete
tools.description: Delete a custom saved report. Rules: Caller must be creator or admin.

report_id.description: Report id or name. Accepts: saved report name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: report_schedules_list
tools.description: List recurring automated report email delivery schedules. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: report_schedule_create
tools.description: Schedule automated recurring generation and email distribution of a report. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin or Report Lead.

cron_expression.description: Schedule cron or frequency. Standard cron format

recipients.description: Email list. Array of valid emails

tools.name: report_schedule_update
tools.description: Update frequency, recipients, or enabled status of a recurring report schedule. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin.

schedule_id.description: Schedule id or name. Accepts: schedule name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: report_schedule_delete
tools.description: Delete a report schedule. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin.

schedule_id.description: Schedule id or name. Accepts: schedule name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: report_schedule_run_now
tools.description: Trigger immediate execution and email dispatch of a report schedule out-of-band. Rules: Schedule must exist.

schedule_id.description: Schedule id or name. Accepts: schedule name or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: reports_settings_get
tools.description: Retrieve workspace reporting retention, export limits, and email gateway settings. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: reports_settings_update
tools.description: Update workspace reporting configuration. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin.

tools.name: issue_attachments_list
tools.description: List all file attachments uploaded to an issue. Rules: Issue must exist.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

tools.name: issue_attachment_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete an attachment from an issue and remove the blob from storage. Rules: Caller must be uploader or workspace admin.

issue_id.description: Issue key or id. Accepts: ticket key (e.g. ENG-104) or UUID (resolved server-side)

attachment_id.description: Attachment id. Accepts: attachment id from issue_attachments_list (resolved server-side)

tools.name: github_repositories_list
tools.description: List connected GitHub repositories linked to this workspace. Rules: Caller must belong to workspace.

tools.name: github_repository_link
tools.description: Link a GitHub repository to the workspace to enable auto-closing of issues via PR merges and commit refs. Rules: Caller must be Workspace Admin.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user ONE consolidated clarification when required information is missing or a reference is ambiguous. Renders as chips/form. Prefer this over guessing.

options.description: Candidate answers, e.g. matching entity names.

fields.description: Optional form fields to collect several missing values at once.

tools.name: find_space
tools.description: Find a project (Space) by name or key prefix in the active workspace. Returns candidates with id, name, key.

tools.name: find_list
tools.description: Find lists inside a space (optionally by name). Used to pick the target list for new tickets.

tools.name: find_sprint
tools.description: Find a sprint in a space by name, number or status (planned/active/completed).

tools.name: find_member
tools.description: Find workspace members by name or email. ONLY searches the active workspace (never the platform-wide user directory).

tools.name: find_issue
tools.description: Find tickets by key (ENG-104) or by title text, optionally within a space.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Semantic + keyword search over ticket text, comments, documentation and help content the user may access. Use for "which tickets mention...", "how do I...", "what did we decide about...". Do NOT use for counts/filters/sums: use list/report tools. Returns passages with citations.

tools.name: issue_clone
tools.description: Clone a ticket (title, description, type, priority, points) into a list and link it with relationship "clones". Subtasks and labels are not modeled and are not copied.

tools.name: issue_bulk_update
tools.description: Apply the same change to many tickets, selected by explicit keys or a filter. ALWAYS dry-run first and show count + sample; executes sequentially with per-item results; stops after 3 consecutive failures.

filter.description: space, sprint, status, priority, type, assignee, search

changes.description: Fields to set (status, priority, assignee_id, due_date, story_points) or {"delete": true}.

tools.name: issue_create_from_attachment
tools.description: Create an issue and automatically attach an uploaded chat attachment (screenshot, wireframe, log, or document). Preserves visual context directly on the ticket. Rules: Target list and space must not be frozen.

attachment_id.description: UUID of the uploaded chat attachment to link

list_id.description: Target list id or name (resolved server-side)

description.description: Detailed description, steps to reproduce, or error stack trace in Markdown

assignee_id.description: Assignee member name or user id

tools.name: workspace_scaffold_from_spec
tools.description: Scaffold a Space, Project Lists, Sprint, and candidate Backlog issues extracted from an uploaded PRD or specification document. Always previews a T2 Confirmation Card before executing.

space_key.description: Space key prefix (2-6 uppercase characters, e.g. MOB, PAY)

lists.description: List names to create under the space (e.g. ["Authentication", "Checkout Flow"])

tools.name: bulk_issue_create
tools.description: Batch-create multiple tickets from parsed rows of an uploaded CSV, defect spreadsheet, or backlog table. Previews a T2 Confirmation Card before executing.

issues.description: Array of tickets to batch create
